主要内容: Congress is reportedly allocating $120 million for the security of President Donald Trump and his family, according to The New York Times. The spending bill, which is expected to pass, would provide additional funding to cover the costs of protecting the Trump family, including their business and leisure travel. The Secret Service is expected to receive roughly half of the funding, which would cover security costs during Trump's travels and for Trump Tower in New York, where Melania Trump and Barron Trump reside. Localities such as New York City and Palm Beach County, where Trump frequently visits his Mar-a-Lago resort, have already incurred extra costs since he took office. Some Democrats have criticized the rising security costs for taxpayers. The funding would also be used to reimburse localities for the additional expenses they have incurred.
